description: Screenshot of a retweeted Dan Scavino (verified @DanScavino) tweet from March 8 2020 containing a meme image. description: Photoshopped meme placing former FBI Director James Comey’s face onto a man sitting on a city sidewalk in a sleeping bag, begging with a McDonald’s cup, beside a shuttered storefront. White block text reads ‘WE NEVER THOUGHT SHE’D LOSE!’ — mocking Comey over Hillary Clinton’s 2016 election loss. Two unidentified passersby appear in the background.
flags: Composite/photoshopped image — Comey’s face pasted onto another man’s body

description: Black-and-white Twilight Zone-style meme using a still of host Rod Serling standing beside a vintage television set, cigarette in hand. Text on and around the TV parodies his ‘Imagine, if you will’ intro to mock climate-change policy, claiming people believe the planet’s temperature can be controlled by giving more money to the government. Watermark credits the account @Conservative Thot.
text: Imagine, if you will... A world where people believe that the temperature of the planet can be controlled by giving more money to the government. Follow me. @Conservative Thot.
flags: Political meme mocking climate policy — message is the meme’s claim, not fact
